title: Feywanderer
dek: Three themes. Nine boons. Compare the effects and costs below.
body:
← Browse all blessings

Read down each theme to compare its three tiers. Each boon shows its listed cost. Open “Full original wording” for the complete passage, including its descriptive text.

Tier 11cost
Tier 22cost
Tier 33cost
Theme 1

The Sylvan Friend

Tier 1Cost 1

Speak with beasts and plants as a ritual at will.

Full original wording

You speak the language of life itself, a universal tongue that binds all living things. Speak with beasts and plants as a ritual at will.

Tier 2Cost 2

Once per short rest, charm a beast or fey creature for 1 minute if it fails a Wisdom save (DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier).

Full original wording

Your voice carries the subtle magic of the wild, weaving charm into every word and gesture. Once per short rest, charm a beast or fey creature for 1 minute if it fails a Wisdom save (DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier).

Tier 3Cost 3

Once per short rest, as a bonus action, you may vanish into the Feywild for one round. You return in an unoccupied space you choose within 60 feet.

Full original wording

You are a child of twilight groves and impossible dreams, dancing between worlds with effortless grace. Once per short rest, as a bonus action, you may vanish into the Feywild for one round. You return in an unoccupied space you choose within 60 feet.

Theme 2

The Trickster’s Guile

Tier 1Cost 1

Gain advantage on Deception and Stealth checks

Full original wording

You speak lies so perfectly, even truth forgets itself. Your presence is a secret in motion. Gain advantage on Deception and Stealth checks

Tier 2Cost 2

A number of times equal to your proficiency, impose disadvantage on an enemy’s attack roll as a reaction within 30 feet. On a miss, have them target another target within 30 feet of both you and the attacker. If needed to hit the new target, move them as little as possible to be on safe ground and within range of the new target.

Full original wording

Confusion is your weapon—your enemies strike those closest to them, guided by illusions only you control. A number of times equal to your proficiency, impose disadvantage on an enemy’s attack roll as a reaction within 30 feet. On a miss, have them target another target within 30 feet of both you and the attacker. If needed to hit the new target, move them as little as possible to be on safe ground and within range of the new target.

Tier 3Cost 3

Once per long rest, cast mirror image without expending a spell slot effecting creatures with all but true sight as your images manifest physically

Full original wording

You fracture across the battlefield—illusions dancing beside you, indistinguishable and untouchable. Once per long rest, cast mirror image without expending a spell slot effecting creatures with all but true sight as your images manifest physically

Theme 3

The Verdant Wrath

Tier 1Cost 1

You are unaffected by non magical difficult terrain. As well, when another creature attempts to grapple or restrain you with non magical tools, they must make the check each round to do so. If there was no initial check, they can use athletics for the following rounds.

Full original wording

Your motion mirrors the rhythm of nature—fluid, instinctive, and untouchable. You are unaffected by non magical difficult terrain. As well, when another creature attempts to grapple or restrain you with non magical tools, they must make the check each round to do so. If there was no initial check, they can use athletics for the following rounds.

Tier 2Cost 2

For the purposes of Wildshape, you may now transform into plants as if they were beasts.

Full original wording

You feel the pulse of sap like blood, the stretch of roots like motion. To you, flora is never still. For the purposes of Wildshape, you may now transform into plants as if they were beasts.

Tier 3Cost 3

Once per long rest, you can expell a 6th level spell slot too cause a Wrath of Nature in a 60 foot aura. While this spell is active, you may travel through the roots as if under the effects of Tree stride with a 60 foot distance.

Full original wording

You need not walk to move—roots carry you, leaves listen, and every trunk is a doorway to somewhere else. Once per long rest, you can expell a 6th level spell slot too cause a Wrath of Nature in a 60 foot aura. While this spell is active, you may travel through the roots as if under the effects of Tree stride with a 60 foot distance.
